summary: Iteration 20 - Admin Dashboard features tested. All 12 backend tests passed. All 11 frontend Playwright tests passed. Auto-refresh polling, 'Updated X ago' indicator, stats cards, delete controls, self-delete prevention, admin-only access, and mobile viewport all working correctly.
passed_tests: ADMIN DASHBOARD: Login hello@churvox.com/TempPass123! → redirects to /admin ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Shows 'Updated just now' indicator ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Stats cards show real data (Total Users: 1, Businesses: 1, Jobs: 1, Invoices: 0) ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Click on stat card shows detail records in right panel ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Delete button (red trash icon) visible on user detail cards ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Cannot delete own account (hello@churvox.com) → returns 400 error ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Non-admin user cannot access DELETE /api/admin/users endpoint → returns 403 ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Non-admin user cannot access GET /api/admin/platform-stats → returns 403 ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Refresh stats button works (real mouse click) ✓
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Mobile viewport (375x812) renders correctly ✓
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-refresh polling implemented correctly with setInterval(30s) in useEffect
timeAgo function updates every 10s via tick counter
Self-delete prevention works correctly - backend returns 400 'Cannot delete your own account'
Admin-only access enforced via is_platform_owner() check on both GET stats and DELETE user endpoints
Delete is hard delete from MongoDB (users, business_users, password_reset_tokens collections)
filterFake function filters test/demo/sample accounts from admin view - working as designed
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test user realadmintest@churvox.com during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 verified admin dashboard features: (1) Platform owner login redirects to /admin, (2) 'Updated just now' indicator shows and updates every 10s, (3) Stats cards show real data from MongoDB, (4) Clicking stat card shows detail records in right panel, (5) Delete button visible on user/business cards, (6) Self-delete prevention returns 400 error, (7) Non-admin users get 403 on admin endpoints, (8) Mobile viewport (375x812) renders correctly with stacked cards, (9) Employer/Worker login regression tests pass. Note: filterFake function filters accounts with test/demo/sample in names/emails from admin view.
